lifecycles._note: CDN service CRUD (Wave 2, body tightened 2026-06-20 from live 400 ValidationError; purge body fixed 2026-06-20 from api_docs request_example). REGION GATE (knowledge/formal/services/networking__cdn.yaml cdn-region-availability, docs): Global CDN exists ONLY in kr-west1/kr-east1 — NOT kr-south1/2/3. The engine (regression/scenarios/engine.py) has NO region-guard mechanism today, so the gate is recorded here: on a kr-south profile this lifecycle must be disabled/filtered out (a declarative 'regions' lifecycle key + engine env-skip is FUTURE WORK); current default env is stage-kr-west1, which is in-gate. CDN is a VPC-free control-plane resource, so no shared-VPC adoption. Create -> read -> update -> update-description -> start -> stop -> purge -> delete, all in one optional 'cdn' group so a bad body skips only this family (cleaned up). Bodies from data/api_docs.json request_example + live 400 error correction. create returns $.cdn.resource_id (NOT $.id and NOT $.cdn.id — confirmed from createcdnservice response_example {cdn:{account_id,resource_id,workflow_id}}); captured SOFT into cdn_id. Dependent steps reference {cdn_id}: when create succeeds this is a real reversible chain; when create 4xx's, cdn_id stays unset and {cdn_id} is sent literally — it still norm-matches catalog /v1/cdns/* and records the call (coverage) with an expected 4xx. CONFIRMED ENUMS (from live 400 2026-06-20): cdn_origin_protocol=HTTP|HTTPS; caching_option=HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL_AND_EXPIRES|HONOR_ORIGIN_CACHE_CONTROL|HONOR_ORIGIN_EXPIRES|CACHE; content_policy=ONLY_VALIDATED_CONTENTS (first valid). TYPE FIXES (from live 400 2026-06-20): cdn_origin_port=integer (not string); cache_expiry_time=integer; query_string_ignored=boolean; range_request_allowed=boolean; request_custom_headers=object (not string); response_custom_headers=object (not string). Optional nullable fields dropped: custom_forward_host_header (any of [string,null]). cache_key_hostname=REQUEST_HOST_HEADER, forward_host_header=REQUEST_HOST_HEADER, origin_hostname_type=DOMAIN confirmed from docs. cdn_service_domain_prefix must be globally unique -> regr{ualpha}. PURGE BODY (from api_docs.json request_example 2026-06-20): requires custom_url (path string), target_content (string), target_url (string); empty {} would 400. start/stop sent with empty bodies (no request body in docs). COVERAGE STATUS (2026-06-20): 2/9 covered in read-only mode: listcdnservice (GET /v1/cdns 200, empty or non-empty) + detailcdnservice (GET /v1/cdns/{id} 200, via read_chain using live CDN resources). 7 remaining are all mutating — need SCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true (+SCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE for DELETE). Covers all 7 CDN WRITE ops: POST /v1/cdns, PUT /v1/cdns/{id}, PUT /v1/cdns/{id}/description, POST /v1/cdns/{id}/start, POST /v1/cdns/{id}/stop, POST /v1/cdns/{id}/purge, DELETE /v1/cdns/{id}.

steps.name: stop-cdn
steps._note: REPAIR 2026-07-13 (CDN 안 지워짐 관측): CDN은 async(create→deploying→ACTIVE, stop→stopping)이고 라이프사이클에 poll이 없어 stop이 아직 deploying 중인 CDN을 만나 400/409로 무효화될 수 있다. retry로 CDN이 stoppable 될 때까지 재시도 → 뒤의 delete가 stopped 상태를 만나 성공.

steps.name: wait-cdn-stopped
steps._note: REPAIR 2026-07-13 (라이브 상태머신 실측): CDN은 cdn_service_state = ACTIVE→STOPPING→STOPPED (별도로 cdn_service_activation_state). stop-cdn은 async라 STOPPING이 장시간 걸리고(regrefjnmoon 실측 3분+), 그 사이 delete-cdn을 쏘면 400이 아니라 **404 ResourceNotFound**(transitioning 자원 미노출)를 뱉는다 → expect의 404 관용에 삼켜지고 retry(400/409)도 안 걸려 조용히 누수. 그래서 delete 전에 STOPPED 정착을 폴한다. give_up[404]=이미 소멸(성공), timeout 600s 후엔 통과하고 delete의 retry+reconciler 백스톱. STOPPED enum은 STOPPING의 자연쌍 추정(states 미문서화) — 라이브가 정정.

steps.name: delete-cdn
steps._note: REPAIR 2026-07-13 (CDN 안 지워짐 관측 — regrefjnmoon 잔존): 앞의 wait-cdn-stopped가 STOPPED 정착을 보장한 뒤 delete → 204. retry[400,409] 10×20s는 남은 transient 방어. 주의: STOPPING 중 delete는 404(오해 유발)이므로 반드시 wait 선행. expect_status는 role 계약(networking-cdn-reads 노트) 유지.

lifecycles._note: 2026-07-08 완전성 편입(COMPLETENESS-AUDIT-2026-07-08, cdn gap 1/9: listcdnservice). READ-ONLY verify lifecycle 신설 — networking-cdn-service(probe, 전 mutating tolerant)는 건드리지 않는다: 거기에 strict read를 추가하면 tolerant 비율 하락으로 role 파생(HEAVY-PREMISE CONTRACT §1)이 probe→verify로 뒤집혀 placeholder-id 쓰기들이 2xx-target verify 레인에 유입될 수 있기 때문. 이 lifecycle은 mutating 스텝 0 → role 자동 verify. 전역 bare list만 담음(빈 목록 200도 실검증) — owner 규정상 placeholder-id read(404 노이즈)는 넣지 않는다. live 200 2026-07-08 (빈 목록, 응답 envelope cdn). REGION GATE(networking-cdn-service 노트 승계): Global CDN은 kr-west1/kr-east1 전용 — kr-south 프로필에서는 이 lifecycle도 disable 필요; 현재 기본 env stage-kr-west1은 in-gate.
